audit-api.description: Audit a packages/api/* package against ADR-0001 TanStack Query conventions (read-only)

vanillaize-builders.description: Move app-preference options out of a resource's option builders to consumer call sites (ADR-0001 Rule 1)

canonicalize-keys.description: Replace a resource's query-key factory with the canonical shape and rewrite call sites (ADR-0001 Rule 4)

migrate-barrel-imports.description: Move a resource's symbols off an API package root barrel onto its subpath (ADR-0001 Rule 3)

delete-barrel.description: Delete an API package root barrel once no consumer imports from it (ADR-0001 Rule 3)

migrate-to-library.description: Migrate a Studio Manager app from Module Federation to workspace library

migrate-filenames-to-kebab-case.description: Rename package source files to kebab-case and update local references

upgrade-pnpm.description: Update the repo's pinned pnpm version with guardrails for stable, non-breaking upgrades
